component.name: bilidown
component.summary: A cross-platform video downloader for Bilibili

description.p: bilidown is a cross-platform desktop application for downloading videos from Bilibili. It parses a shared link or ID and lets you pick exactly which episodes, quality and extra content to save. Fork of Bili23 Downloader, rewritten in Rust.

ul.li: Downloads videos, bangumi, courses, favourites, user spaces and audio
Supports up to 8K resolution, HDR, Dolby Vision and Hi-Res audio
Saves danmaku, subtitles, cover art, chapters and NFO metadata alongside the video
Multi-threaded downloading with resume support and configurable speed limits
